findings.title: No data connections were enumerated
findings.detail:
**Fact surfaced (per `connections`):** the task output is an empty array (`[]`). No connection ids, tables, files, or schema sources were returned.

**Implication (mine, not surfaced upstream):** an empty enumeration means only that this run found no registered/indexed data connections. It does not by itself establish that the repository uses no data sources; the enumeration may simply have had nothing registered to list. No schema-level claim can be made from this output.

findings.title: No schema, object-listing, or distribution outputs were available
findings.detail: The upstream block contains only the `connections` output. No per-table or per-file schema, object listing, or distribution summary was handed to this aggregation, so this report names no tables, columns, files, or types. The focus question ("what data sources and schemas does this repository use") is therefore unanswered by this run beyond the empty connection list (per `connections`).
